name: map_pow_ne_zero
statement: 0 ≤ f) {x : R} (hx : IsUnit x) (hfx : f x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (f_mul : ∀ x y : R, f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) : f (x ^ n) ≠ 0

have_tree.body: by simpa [← mul_pow, hxn] using f_mul (x ^ n) (hx.unit⁻¹ ^ n)

name: seminormFromBounded_aux
statement: 0 ≤ f) (f_mul : ∀ x y : R, f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) (x : R) : 0 ≤ c * f x

name: seminormFromBounded_one
statement: f ≠ 0) (f_nonneg : 0 ≤ f) (f_mul : ∀ x y : R, f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) : seminormFromBounded' f 1 = 1

have_tree.name: h_bdd
have_tree.type: BddAbove (Set.range fun y ↦ f y / f y)

name: seminormFromBounded_of_mul_apply
statement: 0 ≤ f) (f_mul : ∀ x y : R, f (x * y) ≤ c * f x * f y) {x : R} (hx : ∀ y : R, f (x * y) = f x * f y) : seminormFromBounded' f x = f x

have_tree.name: h_bdd
have_tree.type: BddAbove (Set.range fun y ↦ f x * (f y / f y))
